segments.he: גְּמָ׳ אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ בֵּית חֲדוֹדוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר קָיְימָא, וְהָא קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן דְּקָסָבַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה: כֵּיוָן שֶׁהִגִּיעַ שָׂעִיר לַמִּדְבָּר — נַעֲשֵׂית מִצְוָתוֹ.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «Abaye said: Learn from this» that «Beit Ḥiddudo is located in the wilderness, and this» comes to «teach us that Rabbi Yehuda holds that once the goat has reached the wilderness, its mitzva is complete» even before it is pushed off the cliff, and there is no need to wait any longer.
